Your Love Horoscope Is Here For Wednesday, September 23: Be Honest Today
Your zodiac sign's daily love horoscope is here for September 23, 2026. The Aquarius Moon trines Mercury in Libra on Wednesday, encouraging you to be completely honest.
While the Aquarius Moon inspires truth above all else, Mercury in Libra helps you express it in a way that benefits your relationship or dating life. This is not just about being honest with how you feel but choosing what is right for you instead of what you think you should be doing. Embrace authenticity so you can receive the love destined for you.
Love horoscopes for each zodiac sign on Wednesday, September 23, 2026:
Aries
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Say what actually matters, Aries. You deserve a full life, and on Wednesday, you may need to discuss with your partner what that actually means.
You don’t need to spend all your time together, but you do need to communicate how you’re actually feeling. Create space not just for love, but for friends and family. This is about creating a relationship that supports the life you want to live.
Taurus
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Be honest about what you can give, Taurus. Wednesday is all about truth, and for you, that means owning what you can actually give a relationship right now.
It’s better to own the reality of your current situation than pretend it doesn’t exist. You may be preoccupied with family matters or with furthering your career. You can have a healthy relationship through this period, but you first must be honest about how much you actually have to give.
Gemini
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Don’t be afraid to speak your truth, Gemini. You are about to make an important decision in your life. This could lead to commitment or marriage with the person you love, but remember that you have a say in what that looks like.
Your partner may be more of a traditionalist, but you are finding yourself drawn to the unconventional. On Wednesday, be honest about the kind of commitment you want and what a marriage based in your truth would actually look like.
Cancer
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
This can work out, Cancer, but you must change your perspective toward the connection in your life. On Wednesday, you are urged to challenge the blueprint you’ve been given for love. Just because you followed a specific formula before doesn’t mean you are meant to now.
Honor your authentic desires for love, even if that means maintaining greater independence. Your relationship may not look how you expected, but that's OK.
Leo
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Honor your feelings, but be open to discussing them, Leo. September 23 brings about an important conversation in your romantic life. Be honest with your partner about your feelings and hold space for their thoughts too.
On Wednesday, talk about your future. A relationship isn’t solely based on feelings but on how you can build a life together. That is what you are meant to focus on now.
Virgo
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Decide what matters most, Virgo. Focus on what you deserve in relationships, but also make sure you're not giving more than you’re receiving.
Wednesday's energy helps you understand what you need in your life so you can make sure you recieve it. You must figure this out on your own before having a conversation with your partner. Otherwise, you may get talked into accepting less.
Libra
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Do what feels good to your soul, Libra. While this is only the start of your zodiac season, the universe is wasting no time bringing divine occurrences into your romantic life.
On Wednesday, speak up about what and who you truly want. With the Aquarius Moon, you are thinking about commitment; however, it will look different than the relationships in your past. Don’t just go with the flow, but honor what feels meant for you.
Scorpio
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
You sometimes get caught up in your head, Scorpio, worrying about what you should say or how honest you should be. On Wednesday, let go of this pressure. You don't need to express yourself perfectly or decide the rest of your life this very second.
You are in a phase of freedom and learning what is authentic for you. While you should say yes to new opportunities, you don't need to commit to any one path. Your future is changing more rapidly than you know.
Sagittarius
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Reach out to a trusted friend on Wednesday, Sagittarius. You are trying to figure out what to do with a new emotional truth. This could relate to someone new in your life or the sudden realization that you are in love.
Whatever it is, talk through it with a trusted friend before taking action. Just be sure the person you talk to truly has your best interests at heart, and not their own agenda.
Capricorn
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
You can’t quantify love, Capricorn. No matter how hard you try to make logical decisions or guarantee success in your romantic life, that's just not possible. Instead, you must put in the work and learn to communicate better and trust your instincts.
On Wednesday, you may need to have an uncomfortable conversation. It won't be easy, but it will bring greater clarity moving forward. Hold space for the process instead of rushing to a conclusion.
Aquarius
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Listen to your heart, Aquarius. There will always be external noise and people with loud opinions about what you should do. However, you must tune all that out.
On Wednesday, you are on the verge of a beautiful new chapter in your romantic life, but you must listen to your heart to fully embrace it. Practice slowing your mind down and focusing on your breathing, as you need to be in a calm place to truly make your own decisions.
Pisces
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Let them in, Pisces. Someone in your life wants to know the real you. The only issue is that you’ve gotten so used to keeping everything to yourself that it is difficult to open up. It’s not that you don’t trust them, but when left to your own devices, you develop a strong inner world.
Yet, love means letting someone in, even if you’re not sure how. On Wednesday, say more instead of less. Don’t be afraid to show this special person the unique way you see the world.
Kate Rose is a writer, spiritual astrologist, relationship and life intuitive counselor, and bespoke retreat curator.

They're great, very romantic days that most likely end with smooching. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday return you to the ordinary world of working, exercising, errands, but a phone call on Sunday to you-know-who would go over smashingly.
Taurus
Thursday, Friday, and Saturday (fun days already, generally speaking) have the added magic of being particularly romantic. Monday? Not so much. It's not a bad day. You'll probably eat some delicious things and have fun in social settings. It's just not romantic. Tuesday and Wednesday are outright annoying, featuring encounters with people who want things they aren't able to articulate. But Thursday, Friday, and Saturday are very different. Blossoms figure in the stars, which is appropriate metaphorically. On Sunday, you have a spring in your step.
Gemini
The end of this week, Sunday, to be exact, is romantic. Sunday is a blast. Sunday gives you the opportunity to focus exclusively on you-know-who, and when you focus on someone, you dazzle like no one else can. Put all your eggs into the basket that is Sunday, because the rest of the week is kind of generic. Monday is a classic Monday: hazy, stressful. Tuesday and Wednesday are fun enough, crowded with like-minded people, and you get good ideas, but nothing happens that has the frisson of love. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday are bogged down by family. But then there's Sunday. Wonderful, action-packed, heart-fluttering Sunday!
Cancer
Though you're not particularly disposed to romance this week, Monday is a perfect day for new beginnings. If you're single, it's time to flirt with you-know-who. It's a good day to be assertive. Tuesday and Wednesday find you making a purchase with the future in mind, possibly by yourself, possibly with someone (perhaps a romantic partner). Thursday, Friday, and Saturday are better for cleaning the house than for painting the town, but cleaning the house can be fun (in a dorky way). Sunday is less fun. The house may be clean, but something's out of order. You'll figure it out.
Leo
If you're single, this isn't the week that's going to change that (except maybe on Sunday). But if you already have someone special, this week is bliss. Monday is sweet and calming, the kind of day when you feel like sitting under a tree with someone and drinking tea. On Tuesday and Wednesday, you're glowing from within. Everyone is showering you with praise. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday are mundane by comparison. You're surrounded by yellow pads full of scribbling about the future, financial projections...stuff like that. Sunday is straight out of a romance novel. In a good way.

Virgo
You have a talent for doing things on your own and doing them better than someone with an army of assistants could do. But not on Monday. You could use a couple of assistants on Monday. Or at least a few friends standing on the sidelines and giving you advice. It's not a particularly romantic week, but if you get done what you hope to, you're going to become practically famous, which could bode well for your romantic future. It's true that your happiness often directly corresponds to the extent to which people want to be around you. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday are particularly happy days.
Libra

You could be feeling more sensitive than usual, and it might be harder to clearly express how you're feeling. If you have something important to say to a lover, give yourself the time to find the right words. Midweek is a beautiful time to truly feel your feelings. The good, the bad, and the ugly. By week's end, you'll encounter an incredibly forgiving moment, helping you treat yourself with compassion as you embark on a new chapter.
Scorpio
Your dreams are hard to fathom on Monday. What could your subconscious be telling you? And what does it have to do with your love life? Good questions. This week offers little in the way of answers. A fight with your boss could well take place on Tuesday or Wednesday, but Thursday, Friday, and Saturday are mellow, though not without flashes of excitement. A friend has been keeping something from you and they're finally going to spill it. Exciting! If you have a secret to confess, now is the time. Nothing new happens on the romance front on Sunday, but it's an easy, pleasant day.
Sagittarius
It's entirely possible that you and you-know-who are right for each other, but it doesn't seem like it on Monday. Mismatched energies are confusing everything. You don't want to go out...your love interest does...then you both change your minds. Stay in. On Tuesday and Wednesday, travel is in the stars. Whether it's a trip down the highway or through the clouds, it goes well. On Thursday, Friday, and Saturday, other people are once again making you nuts (even people you love), but on Sunday, you're reminded of what you see in them.
Capricorn
You and you-know-who are in the middle of a disagreement on Monday, and nothing you say seems to make it any better. It's likely that they're overreacting. Then again, you're not the best judge. Expect extremes in energy and almost nothing in the way of romance on Tuesday and Wednesday. A difference of opinion at work might lead to outright bickering. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday are the highlight of the week, what with you connecting with old friends and getting tons done, but you probably won't end up snuggling on the couch with anyone. Sunday is perfect for a fresh, new start.
Aquarius
You're feeling very sensitive on Monday, which isn't always the best thing when it comes to your romantic life. It can confuse issues. It can create issues where there aren't any. Stop thinking so much and go where your natural energy leads. Tuesday and Wednesday are relationship oriented. Compromise, flexibility, and extraordinary connections figure strongly. But on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday, the romantic content of your life is overshadowed by business (or at least financial) matters. Sunday would be a good time to call you-know-who just to chat.
Pisces
You put on a fun love song and dance around your house in your underwear on Monday. Or at least you do this in your mind. Monday is one of those super fun romantic days. On Tuesday and Wednesday, you're doing more serious forms of exercise than dancing in your underwear (it's a shame that can't be your sole way of keeping fit!), but on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday, you're not in a very active mood. Your current relationship has hit a snag, and you two have to talk it through. Sunday has you wondering if it's going to work out.

Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango

Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango

Scorpio
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Your magnetism and intensity are at an all-time high with Venus transiting through your 1st house. If you don't feel attractive and emboldened this week, I'd be very surprised.
Scorpio, keep that same energy this weekend because if you have been idolizing someone, prepare for the Full Moon to bring you back down to earth. This doesn’t mean an ending is inevitable, but it does mean you may have to adjust your expectations a bit.
Sagittarius
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
You may crave a far-away adventure and even make plans for one this week. But hey, what else is new?
The Full Moon lands in your 5th house of love this weekend. If things in a relationship seem different or not as fiery as you are used to, use this moon to reflect on whether or not you are truly aligned with your love interest or person of interest.

Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango

Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
This is actually a great week for your love life, Aquarius. You're about to reach a turning point for the better as past tensions make way for a more balanced outlook.
The Aries Full Moon falls in your 3rd house on Saturday, making you feel more social and talkative this weekend. I think you're ready for a short adventure.

Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
The Sun leaves your 7th house of partners on Tuesday and enters your 8th house, which is far deeper and more profound energy.
Venus is transiting through Scorpio, which is a complementary sign for you. You may be interested in someone who lives at a distance or even in another country.
Over the weekend, the Aries moon sheds light on the condition of your personal self-worth and how this affects your romantic choices for better or worse.

Your Love Horoscope Is Here For Sunday, September 20: That Conversation Won't Wait Much Longer
Your zodiac sign's daily love horoscope is here for September 20, 2026. The Capricorn Moon squares Mercury in Libra on Sunday, encouraging you to ask for what you need in your love life.
This energy is all about emotional reassurance. To feel confident in your relationship, you need to know your feelings are reciprocated. Rather than guessing how the other person feels, ask. If you want to know if they love you, this is the day to find out. If you’re hoping to talk about the future, it’s time to bring up that conversation. No matter where you stand in your relationship, it’s better to know for sure.
Love horoscopes for each zodiac sign on Sunday, September 20, 2026:
Aries
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Be clear on your reasons, Aries. While you're searching for genuine love, you must be mindful of your reasons. This means that despite your desire for love or connection, you may also be looking for validation in your relationship.
Honor this very human need to know that you and your partner both value this connection. On Sunday, ask them how they feel. This will help you have the clarity you need and feel more secure in the future.
Taurus
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Honor your need for emotional safety, Taurus. Love is always a risk; however, that doesn’t mean you should take a chance without the knowledge to back it up.
Before you take a leap of faith, make sure the person you’re leaping with is going to do the same. On Sunday, don’t be afraid to talk about what you imagine your life will look like together, or the kinds of changes you’re both craving. This will help you feel confident that the only risk you’re taking is a new beginning together.
Gemini
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Don’t be afraid to talk it out, Gemini. Talking is one of your strengths, but you must make sure you’re saying what really matters on Sunday.
Instead of focusing on the fun and beautiful bits of a life together, get down to the nitty-gritty that actually defines a relationship. Whether this includes financial matters or your emotional needs, the more real you get, the better you will feel about where this connection is headed.
Cancer
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
You deserve the love and life you’re dreaming of, Cancer. That includes the home and family, but you must make sure your partner is on the same page as you.
On Sunday, ask the hard questions and genuinely listen to their answers. It may be tempting to think they’ll change their mind eventually or that this will work itself out, but you need to prioritize truth over feelings right now.
Leo
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Create your own sense of inner safety, Leo. While a relationship should be your safe place in the world, it’s not your partner's responsibility to make you feel safe. You have to be willing to do some of that work on your own.
Learn to trust yourself and provide what you need. This will help you receive a healthy partner and not make them feel like they're carrying the weight of the relationship.
Virgo
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
You deserve to be valued, Virgo. That means your partner sees you for all that you are. They don’t take you for granted or dismiss your unique energy as something they can receive from just anyone.
Yet that doesn’t mean you’ve been feeling this way. On Sunday, bring up how you’ve been feeling and what you need. This situation won't resolve itself on its own.
Libra
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Design the life you want, Libra. As much as your zodiac sign represents partnership, you must create the life you want to live for yourself. You can’t give up your dreams or needs in an effort to fake intimacy in a relationship.
On Sunday, be sure you’re prioritizing your desires, especially those involving home or emotional safety. Don't wait for your love interest or partner to do it for you.
Scorpio
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Let yourself be seen for all you are, Scorpio. You don’t have to hide your darkness to be loved. In the early stages of relationships, you often try to come across as lighter than you really are. This can mean gaslighting yourself about what you’ve been through or even survived, but that’s not what genuine love is based on.
On Sunday, choose to reveal your most authentic self and be honest about who you are. That is the only way to receive what you truly deserve.
